description: This file contains Swagger API resource classes for the Interest Rate Charts API in the Fineract project. It defines data transfer objects (DTOs) with Swagger annotations for API documentation, such as request and response schemas related to interest rate charts.

classes.name: InterestRateChartsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Swagger API resource class containing DTOs for interest rate chart endpoints

classes.name: GetInterestRateChartsTemplateResponse
classes.description: Response schema for retrieving interest rate chart templates

classes.name: GetInterestRateChartsTemplatePeriodTypes
classes.description: Represents different period types in the template response

classes.name: GetInterestRateChartsResponse
classes.description: Schema for the interest rate charts retrieval response

classes.name: GetInterestRateChartsChartSlabs
classes.description: Represents individual chart slab details within the chart response

classes.name: GetInterestRateChartsCurrency
classes.description: Currency details associated with the interest rate chart

classes.name: PostInterestRateChartsRequest
classes.description: Request schema for creating a new interest rate chart

classes.name: PostInterestRateChartsResponse
classes.description: Response containing the ID of newly created interest rate chart

classes.name: PutInterestRateChartsChartIdRequest
classes.description: Request schema for updating an interest rate chart by ID

classes.name: PutInterestRateChartsChartIdResponse
classes.description: Response after updating an interest rate chart

classes.name: DeleteInterestRateChartsChartIdResponse
classes.description: Response after deleting an interest rate chart by ID
